cruise.label: 和爸妈坐一次邮轮（远景人物）
cruise.wish: Take a cruise trip with my mom and dad — the three of us at the ship railing, ocean wind in our faces.

S.label: 火柴人（现状）

<svg viewBox="0 0 400 220" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">

    <!-- Midground: The Ship's Railing and Ocean Waves -->

    <!-- Hero: The Three Figures -->

</svg>
